configSchema.description: Configure a Jev key to make judgment available; unexpected-stop detection requires separate opt-in and is off by default.

zh-CN.description: 填上 Jev 的 key 即可启用判断模型；意外收工检测默认关闭，需要另外手动开启。

model.description: Model id on the selected route.
Model id on the selected route.

fallback.description: Optional native fallback; never a chat fallback.

enabled.description: Opt in to redacted model judgment. Human effectiveness evaluation has not been performed.
Opt in to redacted model judgment. Human effectiveness evaluation has not been performed.
Opt in to unexpected-stop detection. Real-session effectiveness has not been evaluated.

zh-CN.description: 手动开启意外收工检测。真实会话效果尚未评测。

metadata.summary: Optional unexpected-stop detection, semantic source finding and batch judgment.
metadata.description: All uses are off by default. Stop detection sends redacted request/reply excerpts (2,000/8,000 characters). find_relevant locally scans workspace files and sends redacted query, candidate paths, summaries (256 original characters) and source windows (8 KiB each) from at most 20 fresh 1 MiB file prefixes. judge_batch sends up to 500 redacted JSON states plus redacted question text; unsafe question or choice identifiers are refused. Remote providers receive remaining content; redaction does not remove all confidential information. Native probabilities and text decisions differ. Human effectiveness evaluations have not been performed.

zh-CN.summary: 可选的意外收工检测、语义源码查找与批量判断。
zh-CN.description: 全部用途默认关闭。收工检测发送遮蔽后的请求/回复摘录（2,000/8,000 字符）。find_relevant 在工作区本地扫描后，发送遮蔽后的查询、候选路径、摘要（256 原始字符）和源码窗口（每段 8 KiB），最多来自 20 个文件各自新读的前 1 MiB。judge_batch 发送最多 500 条遮蔽后的 JSON 状态及题目文本；含凭据的题目或选项标识整批拒绝。远程服务会收到剩余内容，遮蔽不能移除所有机密。原生概率与文字决策不同；真实人工效果评测尚未执行。
